{{Quote|Paranoia and hostility. No manifestation yet of Force powers he should not possess. Master Cilghal gave him a concussion and a broken nose|Shul Vaal on Sothais Saar|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
'''Shul Vaal''' was a middle-aged [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[New Jedi Order]]. He served as a [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] and aide to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] at the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sothais Saar]] was brought in after suffering the same [[Force psychosis|illness]] that a group of Knights had contracted.<ref name="Backlash" />

Vaal had soothing manners, emanating calm even when chaotic events were occurring around him.<ref name="Backlash" />
